visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a sunlit courtyard of a traditional wooden and brick building. A professional chef dressed in a pristine white uniform emerges from a dark doorway, smiling warmly. To his left and right, a male host and a female host, both wearing pink aprons and bright smiles, clap enthusiastically to welcome him. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the rustic textures of the wooden frames and stone steps. (2) In an indoor kitchen setting with soft artificial lighting, the chef stands behind a wooden counter. He holds a white card titled 'Today's Menu' listing 'Hakka Stir-fry' and 'Mei Gan Kou Rou' in black text. He uses expressive hand gestures, pointing his index finger as he explains the cooking process. The hosts stand beside him, listening intently with curious expressions, while festive red decorations hang on the wall behind them. (3) The scene transitions to a modern supermarket exterior under a clear blue sky. The two hosts push a metal shopping cart towards the glass entrance. Inside, the aisles are well-lit with fluorescent lights, showing rows of neatly packaged goods. The hosts pick up bottles of grass jelly and boxes of local products, examining the labels closely with their hands. Their expressions are lively as they discuss the ingredients. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a smartphone screen and a physical QR code stand on a store counter. The male host points his phone's camera at the QR code to demonstrate a payment process. Colorful digital icons representing payment steps appear on the screen. The setting is a clean retail environment with visible shelves of produce in the background, maintaining a high-energy promotional atmosphere. (5) The final phase takes place at a dining table where the three individuals are seated. Plates of glistening, dark-sauced Hakka Stir-fry and fatty pork belly (Mei Gan Kou Rou) are shown in extreme close-up, steaming slightly. The characters use chopsticks to pick up the food, eating with exaggerated delight. The background features a mix of indoor home elements and a window looking out to a garden, with bright, warm colors dominating the frame.
